---
title: Stellar payouts
description: Test-only `rail: stellar` for an allowlisted organization. Memo is the payout id.
---

import { Tabs, Tab } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';
import { Callout } from '@/components/docs/docs-callout';

Use **`POST /payouts`** with `rail: "stellar"` to hop merchant USD or XOF through Circle USDC on Stellar. Merchants never hold keys. USDC is treasury, not an `accounts` currency.

<Callout type="warn">
  Stellar payouts are Test-only until your organization is allowlisted and live is explicitly enabled. Send a **test** API key (`lomi_sk_test_…`) to `https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa`. Repeat the same `payout_id` (or `Idempotency-Key`) to get one chain Payment.
</Callout>

## Create

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
import { LomiSDK } from '@lomi./sdk';

const lomi = new LomiSDK({
  apiKey: process.env.LOMI_SECRET_KEY!,
  environment: 'test',
});

const payout = await lomi.payouts.create({
  destination: 'self',
  rail: 'stellar',
  amount: 10,
  currency_code: 'USD',
});
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa/payouts" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "destination": "self",
    "rail": "stellar",
    "amount": 10,
    "currency_code": "USD"
  }'
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

The response includes `stellar_transaction_id` when the hop lands. The dashboard payout row shows that id (read-only). Last mile stays Wave / MTN / SPI after the USDC Payment (`memo` = first 28 of `payout_id`). Optional `last_mile_rail` (`wave` | `mtn` | `spi` | `bank`, default `wave`) records which last mile follows the hop. Stellar sits beside Airwallex (`rail: bank`); it does not intercept bank payouts.

See also [Payouts](/build/money/payouts).
